Main theorem is conditional on p_R; restoration clauses import specific recorded bounds and inherit any unresolved premise in those bounds.
Analytic dense-cube and two-role code-status obstructions delimit own-row rule, without disproving alternative trees.
Conditional composition and imported round-bound instantiations are distinct; inherited audit concern is not silently repaired.
Proof excludes only current and earlier term pin labels rather than all cube pins; removes unknown filling-row pin-status ambiguity.
Hypergeometric richness proved locally; main theorem accepts p_R. Claims restoring unconditional switching inherit exact hypotheses and unresolved premises of imported p_R.
Conditional on both round and wide-move bounds for same tree; does not prove a wide-move bound. Later wide-round theorem replaces it.
Shared-cube analytic example and distinct near-full patterns refute usefulness of complete-term wide-move bound, not switching of the reader.
Only unplaced wide rows are skipped; residual row axioms and exclusions justify image sum. No repetition of refuted placed-row q-skip rule.
Fixed root vertex-cover charges each wide row/hole once; standard Konig equality recorded as external prerequisite with local provenance, no fresh source audit.
Light matching count uses uniform residual subset and union bound, not disputed injection-event negative association; exact polynomial mass regime retained.
Transfer does not reprove probabilistic heavy-host premise; therefore inherits its audit concern. Exposure/few-row/two-role transfers explicitly excluded at this stage.
Theorem is conditional on p_R and p_W; local decoder/count leave wide rows unplaced. No unconditional round estimate inferred.
Pin-free corollary does not import any dense pinned-host avoidance claim; width overlap and rare narrow incidences accounted explicitly.
Role-separated corollary imports p_R from flagged round chain; distinct from pin-free corollary sharing source anchor.
Reordering preserves conditional results and existing corollaries with their original premises; it does not repair probabilistic prerequisites.
Path labeling and consistency proof supplies the two exposed-row facts. Explicit round-first counterexample explains need for reordering.
Transfer rechecks only tree-dependent facts; unchanged probabilistic H/K/E steps retain any audit concerns in their source proofs.
Uniform residual-subset factorial ratio and union bound prove few-wide-row matching tail directly; no injection-event NA assumption.

Uses size-round estimate rather than mass; inherits its unresolved probabilistic premise.
Literal union of row cubes sharpens degree/mass bookkeeping only.

Extra cover entropy recomputed explicitly; analytic extension not implemented in checker.
Open analysis, not established concentration theorem; mass concentration and alive-pin count remain missing and NA premise is additionally flagged.
Conjecture and route-review synthesis, not theorem. Previously recorded claimed cases retain their hypotheses and any subsequent audit caveats.
Open dense-form distribution/coverage/certificate question. Sparse-row argument and deterministic equal-function constants are orientation calculations, not a proof of the general question.
Surjective coefficient restriction and independent uniform constant prove distribution invariance directly; no randomness of compact restriction required for fixed-shape statement.
Exact Boolean function packing argument provided locally; restricted-rank choice is refinement, not a new generic packing theorem.
Multilinear minimum support and union over dual functionals proved locally; rank refers to product width with independent random forms, no forced independence conditioning.
Two-point independence and variance computed directly. Contradicts general coverage hypothesis at balanced rank, not existence of every possible PHP-relative image.
Exact finite linear systems and closure tests, with omitted Booleanity condition: infeasible is definitive within tested image ansatz, feasible only necessary. No general theorem or new run.
Prefix telescoping and multilinear-in-new-variables degree accounting reproduced locally; general fresh-block substitution refinement, not a new PHP-specific theorem.
Finite low-slack evidence only; recorded weak power and non-substitution extension distinction retained.
Analytic monomial feasibility count limits plain elimination; symmetry/quotient/other bases remain untested, not ruled out.
Imported literature context with original-variable-only scope; no theorem in notebook claimed to depend on these papers. Source audit preserved, no new retrieval.
Explicit restatement and withdrawn route: only cheap low-rank collapse, not a levelwise general elimination mechanism.
Weighted binary case-split argument proved here; shared section pure-source reduction and generic question are separate claims.
Pure-source conditional reduction is proved; generic hardness Question H remains open, not implied by finite counts.
Finite generic-axiom tipping experiment only; generic ranks/controls and low-power limits retained.
General image-or-value conjecture for compiled sources, not theorem; union-source incompatibility is a falsification target, not a completed refutation.
Proves untwisted/rowwise escape; generic row-mixing case is equivalent obligation, not established hardness.
Safe definition imported with attribution; detector proof and explicit unary restriction each preserve all stated original degrees.
Conjecture about generic unary subspace hardness with explicit elementary upper comparison; tiny tipping data do not settle scaling.
Imported context; only safe-system definition is used by following result. Expander hypotheses and bit-to-graph transfer are explicitly unchecked.
Nonempty affine flat and binary field required; exact maximum with original collision axiom degree retained. Genericity not needed.
Finite closures in bit degree; not comparable directly to preceding unary-degree tipping data.
Pointwise supported weights and product-set detectors excluded in stated regimes; no impossibility for arbitrary ideal-relative weights or all designs.

Halving count explicit; no generic-subspace lower bound follows.

Density-halving delayer and whole-space collision-pair counting proved directly; generic W lacks the symmetric whole-space identification.
Exact finite Walsh spectra and partial subspace search; best found boosts are lower bounds, spectral estimates upper bounds, unproved general coefficient maximum retained.
Sequential conditional laws and pivot counting proved locally for injective and one-collision labelings; no general wide-query conclusion.
Parked-line assessment; rigorous absolute-value obstruction separated from explicitly heuristic mixed programme, and generic-W transfer not carried out. Citations are context, not new proofs.

Rank of top-degree projection directly proves forced-fall inequality; Hilbert-series model following it remains conditional, not an established prerequisite.
Exact finite NS-space and falls data with small boundary deviations retained; generic equal ranks across seeds not independent evidence.
Explicit conjectural semi-regular series relative to base, supported only by finite low-degree runs. No assertion for proof-selected forms.

Exterior-space sufficient criterion and Cartan coefficient argument given locally; not necessary in every small instance.
R1 uses standard symplectic Lagrangian count; R2 sequential exposure and R3 principal-submatrix reconstruction proved locally. External standard count recorded separately, no new literature audit.
Independent random linear parts modulo rows; first-moment sum separates low/high rank and retains finite size inequalities.

Finite tests have power for criterion and R1/R2; asymptotic U/Lb rest on proofs, not these small-board runs.
Higher-degree relative-rank characterization is proposed, not proved; decomposable trivial-vanishing issue identified explicitly and HW parked.
Ordinary polynomial restriction, not pointwise finite-field vanishing. Later Lean artifact verifies full arbitrary-U assembly; no kernel replay performed.
Shared Lean module also contains generic DAG theorem; those later declarations are not dependencies of initial bridge. Bit-PHP bridge is specialization/comparison only.
Shared artifact split by declaration ownership; no inferred dependency on unrelated imported helper names or bit-PHP-specific theorem.
Elementary binomial exponential estimate proved in place; r<=v hypothesis essential, density interpretation is not a new formal asymptotic theorem.
Complementary affine pair gives trivial refutation by addition; no audit of all known short Res-parity families.
Editorial publication audit, no new theorem or Lean proof. Source/label/recipe checks and existing pinned kernel evidence are provenance, not mathematical prerequisites.
